review_description: East Coast Energy Solutions were easy to communicate with in the quotation process. Jon listened to my preferences and questions and providing appropriate responses and details to help my understanding of the options. I chose to seek a quote from them because the products they offer were aligned with my preferences but I chose to install with them based on price compared to other offers, the customer interactions that I had and the in-house installation team and support.The installation team were efficient and tidy. Cory happily answered my questions about the installation and the system and also offered professional opinions when asked re future proofing for batteries and EV charging in our home.The handover was well setup and streamlined. I did have several follow up questions and was able to contact Gina and Chris on separate occasions, who happily provided the information I was looking for.

The sales and quoting was professional and helpful no matter how many times I contacted them for information.There was never any pressure to select one system over another, just helpful advice.The install crew was punctual, efficient and tidy. They were very accomodating to my requests regarding me cleaning, replacing rusty screws and repairing minor damaged paint under the old system that was being removed prior to the new system install. I was shown the way the new system was setup and connected to the main switchboard and how to shutdown and reboot the system if ever necessary. It was explained to me how to set up the password for the first use and shown how the system appears in the online app.

Had an excellent experience from start to finish. Jon explained the options clearly and provided very competitive quotes.The main installer Corey was outstanding to deal with, going above and beyond to check with us throughout the install to make sure we were happy. He treated the job as if it were his own home, even recommending to install the Gateway in our garage despite the extra time and cost involved, ensuring it will last well into the future. Clayton also did a great job with the panels.I would happily recommend East Coast Energy Solutions to anyone in Townsville.

Interaction was positive from the start with a phone call discussion after the company had done some initial imagery analysis of our property. From there multiple options were presented based on how we planned to use the property and how to future proof the system.Professional and courteous interactions with our property manager and tenants was followed up with an efficient install to a high standard.
East Coast Energy Solutions installed my solar. 2 years later and no problems whatsoever and great feedback and service when needed.

From the first conversation with Jon at East Coast Energy Solutions,I knew I found the company to install my system.On the first day of the install Corey and Clayton arrived on time and ready to go .They were both really easy to deal with and explained every step of the installation.It was so refreshing have all my questions answered without a problem .On completion I was talked through the app and the system as a whole ,and our home was left clean and tidySpeaking with Gina and Chris at their head office was also a pleasure and also assisted us with any queriesI would highly recommend this company
To date the sales service and quote process was very informative. System yet to be installed.Note the price quoted below is inclusive of old system removal.

How was the sales/quoting process? ... Excellent.How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?   Yes to all three.How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install?   Top service all round and yes, the electrician set up the grid connection for me. Even came back after work to upgrade the firmware.

Highly recommended  from beginning to end. From quote process fast & gave us alternatives we hadn't considered, to the admin friendly & well organised got the ball rollingquickly & the installers polite, friendly fast & efficient.
Nice and smooth the whole process Jon is the man to talk and Chris the manager
From sales to installation, the team were good to deal with and always professional. Our choice of system was about price and quality. I'm satisfied we got what we paid for.

It's a very competitive market for solar installation, so you can be picky. I found that with the 4 installers who were bidding for my work they varied but in different areas. I almost felt that I was splitting hairs though when I made my final selection,  East Coast Energy. After selecting the system I wanted and paying 25% deposit I was told 4-6 weeks wait for instal but I was lucky the had a cancellation and I got it within  2 weeks. Communication was great as well as the instal team, the sparky Steve seemed like the main guy and he was very respectful of my needs and always offered me options with how the instal proceeded, with positioning of panels and Inverter etc. The team left the site tidy, workmanship was 10/10 and Steve helped me load the operating App and showed me how to use the completed system. I struggle to find anything negative about East Coast except for I found a tech-screw they dropped on my driveway? (at least I found It) I did tell them and we had a chuckle about it.Could not be happier.
Good people to deal with and not pushy at all. They new their product and were neat and tidy. I liked that they had there own installers and not subbies. Would highly  ecommend them.
Installer was informative and no mess left. Awaiting Ergon to apparently change the meter. The installer indicated that it wasn't necessary. Anyway awaiting Ergon in a week's time.
Excellent Customer Service  from sales to installation, the staff are very efficient and professional.

Quality components, good customer service, advice and follow up calls regarding progress, brilliant installers. These guys stood out for all the right reasons. Within two hours of requesting a quote I had five quotes for different system configurations. Other companies failed even returning my call. Signed up next day and three weeks later the system is installed. Installers did a very neat and tidy job - big thanks for that. Would highly recommend.
They are in the business of sales. Sadly they are all willing to disparage each other so I went on equipment quality then price followed by the one who spun the least "Mine is bigger than yours"
Everything as expected but struggling with app and reading data

Good experience from getting a quote to getting system installed, although the waiting period is longer than I expected. I have to call office to chase up as there was no comm regarding where we were. The installation was done quickly on the day, and they were professional.

I was really impressed with the communication, honesty and speed of the application to the installation. The guys were very efficient and cleaned up after the job. Andrew listened to our needs and adjusted the system to suit the local conditions. We felt the quoting was very prompt and reasonable, however it was good to know the information and advice from Solar quotes so we could understand the differences in the products.We have had a bit of an issue with the WiFi installation due to the construction of the house, but otherwise it is smooth. We have a contact for a grid connection and we are able to have regular contact and service backup.So far we are satisfied, however it is not on the grid as it was only installed last week.

Timely quote followed up with further advice.  Installed at the agreed time with no problems.  The qualified electricians and the team cleaned up after the installation and took all of the packing away.
Excellent communication and service. Looks great. Great feedback and information. Owner rang and we had a great chat and he was extremely knowledgeable and friendly.

Sales/Quoting - Jon - Energy Specialist - straight forward, honest, open. He knew the requirements of our power provider and had all the specs at his fingertips. He outlined the benefits of a bigger system without being pushy. We decided to go for a 10.14 kW system instead of 6.6 kW which was our initial plan. Gina - Admin Support - efficient, knowledgeable, answered all our questions. We visited their showroom and spoke to Jon face to face which was invaluable.Installation - Chris - Leader of a first class team. We needed a full meter box upgrade and relocation and Chris knew exactly our requirements and those of our power provider. All the installation work is first class. Very neat and tidy work. They cleaned up after themselves, even down to picking up cable ties. Totally professional. Up and running in two days.Customer Service - Everything went as scheduled. They organised everything, including all communications with power provider. Seamless organisation. We received a welcome pack with the final bill following installation. We will be contacting them shortly to schedule the annual maintenance and ask for clarification on a few minor questions regarding the monitoring system. They made it clear they were there for us if we did have any questions. The fact they are local, Cairns, is a big help. Friendly, knowledgeable, professional. We're very pleased with the whole experience.

Jon from East Coast contacted me within 24 hours of the initial request. Clear communication. Offered a number of options. Can for a site visit and was not a pushy sales person. Installation was completed seamlessly and without drama in one day. System working well. End to end service delivery. We just had to pay the invoice.

East Coast Energy Solutions made the entire process from initial enquiry to actualisation simple, informative and with no obligation to commit.Chris and his entire team were happy to provide answers to our questions, provide location specific guidance and advice, and completed the project quickly with a minimum of fuss and maximum professionalism.I'd recommend East Coast Energy Solutions without reservation to anyone interested in solar in North Queensland.
Happy with the quote,service was good east coast did good job
Very happy with this company so far. Arrived on site as promised.experanced young installers who did a good job in trying conditions site was left clean and tidy.
Corey and Ricky did a fantastic job on our solar system under extreme conditions they certainly know there solar installation it’s a credit to the boys!
Quick efficient order, a few hiccups with communication but answered all queries I had with no hassle.

The quoting was efficient and fast, the installation was scheduled to fit my requirements of getting my roof cleaned and painted first.The installers were polite, efficient, tidy and on time and did an excellent job installing the panels on my roof to make the visual aspect pleasing to the eye and avoiding skylights etc....

The team at East Coast Energy Solutions installed a 13.32kw system at our place in Cairns North Queensland. The whole process was very seamless from the initial quote through to installation. They took care of everything behind the scenes and were always happy to answer any question or query we had. The workmanship of the installation was first class. Excellent job! Would definitely recommend to others.

I found East Coast Energy solutions range of systems quoted and matter of fact technical advice allowed me to chose the one which best suited my needs in terms of size, location practicality, value for money and future servicing.Installation was completed within a week of my quote acceptance and all formalities with the electrical authority were handled without the need for my further input.

Sales, didn't force me to buy anything. One clean information. Installation was prompt and on time, and tidy.Customer service was good but they didn't give me a  call after installation (how things are going). In general I will recommend the company.
Installation, mounting rails left longer I.e. past edge of panels. Roof space electrical is messy. Otherwise good.
Excellent customer service and fast installation. Also reasonable price for good quality system
Good service and tidy installation, very prompt and friendly, to early to tell the outcome.

Everything from this company went smoothly. Quotations, follow ups, install dates, installation all are spot on. The installation crew Weâ€™re especially helpful explaining the system to me and getting 32 panels up on the roof with rain showers all day proved frustrating but they got it done!They have organised the upgrade of the meter and I didnâ€™t really do anything except sign for it. 100% happy I went with east coast energy I will recommend them to everyone. Thanks guys

It took almost a week to get the initial quote through but from then on they were very responsive to my emails and customer service was excellent.  They took care of everything, including removal of the 12y old 2.5kW system (dead inverter).All of the reviews of East Coast Energy that I read said service was excellent, particularly installation.  I have to agree with everyone, they installation crew were great.  Installation was booked for a Monday but I got a call from them on the Friday before to say they'd finished another job early and would it be ok to come Friday afternoon and make a start.  They were due to start at 8am on Monday. I left with the aim of being there 10 mins early to meet them when they arrived, but 2 mins from home I got a call to say they were there and was it ok to start. Better than on-time! The installation was neat as a pin.NBN hadn't been reconnected when they did the install, but when I called a few days later after it was on, they came around within an hour to commission the Smart Meter and upgrade the inverter firmware.I got two quotes for comparable 10.5kW systems and Eastcoast was quite a lot cheaper.  Both quotes were for the same 8kW (SG8K-D) Sungrow grid connect inverter, Sungrow Smart Meter and a hot water timer.  Eastcoast quoted 32 Seraphim Blade half-cut mono PERC 330w panels (10.56kW) and the other quote was for 30 LONGi 350W (10.50kW).  Eastcoast were 25% cheaper.  After a few hours on Google comparing the Seraphim and LONGi panels, and reviews of both companies, I couldn't see any reason not to save 25% and I went with East Coast Energy Solutions.It's been just under a month (27 days), but so far, so good, with a yield of 901.7kWh (33.39kWh/day).  That's a little under the estimated 38kWh/day (other quote estimated 36kWh/day) for June, but we've had a bit of rain and overcast days.  The last 4 days had a yield over 40kWh/day.  I don't have much North facing roof, so the system is split roughly 50/50 East/West.  (A little more on the West side, to grab the afternoon sun).So far I'm very happy with the system and I have no hesitation in recommending East Coast Energy Solutions.

East Coast Energy gave me a prompt very reasonable quote. The installation was carried out very quickly after I gave them the go ahead, the installers were polite and friendly and they performed a very professional and tidy looking installation. Customer service was great and they arranged Ergon to do the grid connection. Unfortunately the system was fitted a month ago and Ergon only came out and performed the meter upgrade and Grid connection today. I have only rated value for money and quality of system midway, due to the fact the connection was only completed today. The only small issue I have is the installers talked me into having the Tarif box removed that the A/C's were hooked too and I am not sure yet whether this was a wise decision or not yet.

East Coast didn't contact me promptly and in those 2 weeks, we had almost signed with another company who had sent a rep. for a site visit before providing a quote. However once in contact, East Coast did explore our needs thoroughly and made suggestions. We were advised of installation date well in advance and installers arrived promptly and worked efficiently. The proposed layout was not suitable and so the electrician/installer devised an excellent layout which suited our curved roof and property standard - he was proud of his work! All the paperwork has been dealt with by East Coast and Ergon will attend to the meter box in a few days.  The system is operating well and we are very happy with our purchase.
Good customer service, ready and happy to talk through all options to determine the best option for our circumstances.
Higher end quality product for a good price, installers were great guys.

A bit slower off the mark than the other companies with getting to us for quoting but nice person and we didnâ€™t feel pressured. Company was happy to mix and match product and pricing offering several quotes at our request. Probably should have asked a few more questions about installation as bought larger system with 2 inverters and apparently one just pumps power to the grid all the time and itâ€™s probably the one should have been house connected due to western side and producing powers later into afternoon when higher energy use in the household with air conditioning. Very young installation team who were nice and professional enough but didnâ€™t really explain much about inverter setup or reading the data. All up happy but still have some questions about metering which I am currently waiting on the power company to connect up so I can see if thatâ€™s the problem with the smart meter showing as having a problem. Iâ€™m sure the company will be happy enough to answer my questions
Sales person gave us a couple of options with pros and cons of both. Did all the paper work for us. Put it up earlier than we thought they would.

Initially responded quickly. Happy to explain how things work and such. Did so in a non-judgmental / spoken down to way.Needed some prompting to email things they said they were going to. Have the wrong bsb on quote. Sent the owner emails that he never acknowledged - e.g. "your bsb is incorrect on your quote, just letting you know" "please find attached the receipt for payment for the system" or a thank you, which would have been nice.The installers from the company were LOVELY. Can't stress this enough, prompt and tried to help out as much as they could. Needed to come back the next day to install the panels as 2 people hadn't installed a 10.71kw system on their own. Felt for them being on the roof in the heat! The install went well, the Fronius system had some wifi issues but the guys sorted it out.
Happy with sales/quoting process. As stated installation still to happen. Other considered company representative was extremely rude and was ruled out on that basis.

We bought two 6kw solar system. One for our farm and the other for our investment property in Atherton. We are happy with East Coast Energy Solution people as they have been very helpful throughout the installation process.

Chris at East Coast Energy Solutions was very prompt with providing a quote and provided excellent service throughout the whole installation.  He has since been around again and commissioned wifi monitoring of the inverters for us.  All in all a great experience and very speedy response with quote and installation.
